name: pixelagents
short: Mirror Discord presence into Pixelpipes via the Agent Control API
description: Observes Discord guild presence and drives agent lifecycle in Pixelpipes through the pixel-agents-node-red Agent Control API.
end_user_data_statement: This cog transmits Discord user IDs, guild IDs, display names, and presence status to a configured Node-RED endpoint.
install_msg: Configure the cog with `[p]pixelagents baseurl` and `[p]pixelagents key`, then enable a guild with `[p]pixelagents enable`.
author: Tin Nguyen
